propositions: Bare imports of alert_dedup in canary_bridge.py and dependency_audit.py fail when test subsets run without scripts/ on sys.path, because full CI runs inject scripts/ at collection time and that side effect leaks across the session.
The import resolution must be invocation-independent (supporting both python scripts/x.py and pytest), ruling out relative imports and scripts/__init__.py.

Both canary_bridge.py and dependency_audit.py must insert scripts/ derived from __file__ idempotently immediately above the bare alert_dedup import, following the pattern established in jira_dc_epic_link_clear_probe.py.

A new AST-scan test (test_scripts_import_convention.py) must verify that all bare sibling imports under scripts/ are preceded by their corresponding sys.path.insert, and that the affected test module collects when run standalone.
